description: Free. Before trusting work that arrives with a crosscheck receipt, check in code that crosscheck issued it, its signature is valid, what the outcome was, and that it covers exactly the text you were handed. Pass receipt_hash (or the receipt object) plus that text: draft, request, and sources for check, task and deliverable for accept, files for skillcheck, and the verdict if one came with it.

deliverable.description: accept: the deliverable the receipt should cover

draft.description: check: the draft the receipt should cover

receipt.description: Or the whole receipt object {body, hash, sig}

receipt_hash.description: The receipt's hash (the last part of its /r/ proof link)

request.description: check: the human's request, if the check had one

sources.description: check: the sources, if the check had any, in the same order (strings or {text})

task.description: accept: the task the receipt should cover

verdict.description: The verdict that came with the receipt, to confirm nobody edited it

name: verify_receipt
title: Verify a crosscheck receipt
